bodyHTML:
Your question in one sentence

How do you validate perception scores from street-view images?

Context and what you tried

I have model-predicted safety scores for 12,000 street segments and a resident survey covering 300 of them. Rank correlation is 0.41; I am not sure that is the right test.

City or geography, if relevant

Any

comments.author: example-member-5
comments.bodyHTML:
Report rank correlation, but also check calibration within neighbourhoods. A model can rank cities well and still miss variation within them.

spearman(score, survey) by tract

comments.author: example-member-7
comments.bodyHTML: Make sure the survey sample is not concentrated on busy streets; reweight if it is.
